## Observation datasets

### cobalt\_hcp\_fujihisa\_1996\_figure3\_digitized

- **Description:** Eight clearly separable high-pressure hcp-Co closed-circle markers digitized from Figure 3. Low-pressure hcp markers overlap the open-circle fcc series at the published figure resolution and were not guessed.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_ratio\_digitized
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Fujihisa; Takemura
    - **Year:** 1996
    - **Source:** Phys. Rev. B
    - **Volume:** 54
    - **Locator:** 5-7
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.54.5
- **Source location:** Figure 3, closed-circle hcp series
- **Associated EOS records:** cobalt\_hcp\_fujihisa\_1996\_vinet\_1

### cobalt\_dewaele\_2008\_table2\_compression

- **Description:** All 25 Co pressure-volume observations transcribed from Dewaele et al. (2008), Table II.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Dewaele; Torrent; Loubeyre; Mezouar
    - **Year:** 2008
    - **Title:** Compression curves of transition metals in the Mbar range: Experiments and projector augmented-wave calculations

    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.78.104102
- **Source location:** Table II
